result.topic_en: Euler sets up the boundary conditions at the free end E and at the support point C for both portions of a vibrating elastic lamina, obtaining six equations for the eight coefficients A, B, C, D and A', B', C', D'.
result.transcription:
484 DE MOTV VIBRATORIO
Pro altera portione F C
$y' = \cos.\theta\theta t(A'\cos.\Phi' + B'\sin.\Phi' + C'e^{\Phi'} + D'e^{-\Phi'})$.
Conſideremus priorem portionem E C pro qua ſi $x = 0$, debet eſſe tam $(\frac{ddy}{dx^2}) = 0$ quam $(\frac{d^3y}{dx^3}) = 0$, vnde ſequuntur hae duae determinationes:
$-A + C + D = 0$ et $-B + C - D = 0$,
quod ſi nunc a termino E vsque ad C progrediamur ſumendo $x = \alpha$ et ponendo $\frac{\theta\alpha}{b} = \zeta$, pro hoc puncto C habemus 1°. $y = 0$ vnde fit
$A\cos.\zeta + B\sin.\zeta + Ce^{\zeta} + De^{-\zeta} = 0$,
praeterea notentur tres ſequentes valores
$(\frac{dy}{dx}) = +\frac{\theta}{b}\cos.\theta\theta t(-A\sin.\zeta + B\cos.\zeta + Ce^{\zeta} - De^{-\zeta})$
$(\frac{ddy}{dx^2}) = \frac{\theta\theta}{bb}\cos.\theta\theta t(-A\cos.\zeta - B\sin.\zeta + Ce^{\zeta} + De^{-\zeta})$
$(\frac{d^3y}{dx^3}) = \frac{\theta^3}{b^3}\cos.\theta\theta t(+A\sin.\zeta - B\cos.\zeta + Ce^{\zeta} - De^{-\zeta})$
quibus formulis indoles curuae circa punctum C determinatur. Simili modo ex altera parte, ſi ſumamus $x' = \beta$ et ponamus $\frac{\theta\beta}{b} = \zeta'$ obtinebimus ſequentes formulas:
$-A' + C' + D' = 0$, $-B' + C' - D' = 0$;
$A'\cos.\zeta' + B'\sin.\zeta' + C'e^{\zeta'} + D'e^{-\zeta'} = 0$
$(\frac{dy'}{dx'}) = \frac{\theta}{b}\cos.\theta\theta t(-A'\sin.\zeta' + B\cos.\zeta' + C'e^{\zeta'} - D'e^{-\zeta'})$
$(\frac{ddy}{dx'^2}) = \frac{\theta\theta}{bb}\cos.\theta\theta t(-A'\cos\zeta' - B'\sin.\zeta' + C'e^{\zeta'} + D'e^{-\zeta'})$
$(\frac{d^3y'}{dx'^3}) = \frac{\theta^3}{b^3}\cos.\theta\theta t(+A'\sin.\zeta' - B'\cos.\zeta' + C'e^{\zeta'} - D'e^{-\zeta'})$.
Hic igitur habemus ſex aequationes determinatas pro determinandis noſtris octo coefficientibus A, B, C, D
et

items.quote: Hic igitur habemus ſex aequationes determinatas pro determinandis noſtris octo coefficientibus A, B, C, D
items.english: Here therefore we have six determinate equations for determining our eight coefficients A, B, C, D [and A', B', C', D'].
